# Erdos.p242 — Erdős problem 242

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/242
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/242.lean`, theorem `erdos_242`, AMS 11).

For every $n>2$ there exist distinct integers $1 ≤ x < y < z$
such that $\frac 4 n = \frac 1 x + \frac 1 y + \frac 1 z$.

## Statement
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n), ∃ x y z : ℕ, 1 ≤ x ∧ x < y ∧ y < z ∧
      (4 / n : ℚ) = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
